title: Polyglot embeddings client: graceful retries, streaming pagination, and explicit typed responses
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Customers report brittle embedding client behavior under transient network failures and large result sets. Current SDKs expose a low-level streaming API that is awkward to paginate and lacks typed contracts across Python/TS. Edge cases observed: partial streams with opaque errors, duplicated results on retry, and poor developer ergonomics for large offset/limit style pagination. Goal: deliver a unified, polyglot client surface (Python + TypeScript) that provides: graceful idempotent retries, clear streaming + page-based pagination primitives, and explicit typed responses (TypedDicts for Python, discriminated unions/interfaces for TS). This should reduce developer errors, improve p95 latency for large-result workflows via smarter chunking, and make failures actionable for production apps.
acceptance_criteria: Python SDK exposes EmbeddingsClient.paginate() that yields TypedDict pages and supports resume tokens
TypeScript SDK exposes EmbeddingsClient.streamPages() returning AsyncGenerator<PageResult> with discriminated union types
Retry policy implemented with idempotency keys, jittered exponential backoff, and safe de-duplication for streaming responses
Pagination supports both offset/limit and cursor/resume-token modes and is documented in README and API reference
Automated integration tests for retry/resume semantics and property tests for no-duplicates on reattempt
Benchmarks show <=20% p95 latency regression for small calls and >=30% improvement for batched paging hotspots compared to current master
SDKs include clear typed error classes for transient vs permanent failures and document recommended app-level retry behavior
implementation_notes: Introduce a lightweight resume token in server response metadata (opaque string) to allow exactly-once paging semantics
Server will include per-page checksum and sequence IDs; client verifies checksum on resume to detect divergence
Retry policy: default 3 attempts, backoff base 200ms, max 3s, full jitter. Override-able per-call.
Streaming paths should expose a small buffering window (configurable) to allow downstream backpressure without blocking RK scheduler
Add client-side request id and optional idempotency_token header for non-streaming calls to make retries safe
Expose Python TypedDict models under redwood.embeddings.types and TS types under @redwood/inference-sdk/embeddings/types
Keep legacy convenience methods (embeddings.create_vector(...)) but mark streaming raw API as low-level and beta-deprecated in docs
Instrument metrics: client.retries.count, client.pages.fetched, client.pages.resume_rate, client.page.size_histogram, and p95 token latency per-page
rollout_plan: Feature branch & internal dogfood: integrate with 3 internal services that use large-scale reranking (week 1)
Beta SDK release (Py/TS) behind feature flag: collect metrics and error telemetry for two weeks
Iterate on ergonomics from dogfood feedback, then opt-in open beta for existing hosted customers
GA release: bump SDK major if we change signatures; otherwise minor with migration notes
Coordinate server-side migrate: add resume token and per-page checksum via runtime-1.21 endpoint flag; leave old endpoint available for 6 weeks
testing_plan: Unit tests for TypedDict/TS typing surface using mypy and TS compiler checks
Fuzz tests for pagination resume to check for duplicates and missing items
Integration tests against a staging runtime that can inject latency, partial streams, and transient 5xx failures
Load test to validate memory usage under 1M total vectors paginated with page size 1k
Chaos job simulating network blips to validate retry/backoff behavior and idempotency preservation
benchmarks: Baseline: current SDK p95 for paginated rerank workflow = 340ms (page size 128)
Target: reduce paginated rerank p95 to <=270ms by optimizing chunked fetch and client-side prefetching
Throughput target: maintain >=95% request success under 2x baseline QPS for embedding pagination
Memory ceiling: client memory growth should remain O(page_size) with configurable prefetch buffer default 2
